tool.name: Update View
tool.description: Update an existing USE-format generative view, either by replacing the whole document or applying targeted patch operations.

id.description: UUID of the view to update (from list_views or create_view)

document.description: Full replacement USE spec document. Use this OR 'patches'.

patches.description: Targeted patch ops. Each: {"op": setProp|removeProp|setComponent|insertChild|removeChild|replaceChild|replaceNode, "path": [child indices from root], ...}. setProp/removeProp take 'key' (+'value'); child ops take 'index' (+'node').

ai.systemPromptSection:
### update_view
Edit a stored USE view. Prefer 'patches' for small changes (token-efficient) and 'document' for full rewrites. Paths are arrays of child indices from the root: [] = root, [0,2] = third child of first child. Get the current document with get_view first when patching.

**Format:**
```tool_request
{"tool":"update_view","query":"{\"id\":\"<uuid>\",\"patches\":[{\"op\":\"setProp\",\"path\":[0],\"key\":\"spacing\",\"value\":24}]}"}
```

The result is validated before saving (atomic: a failing patch changes nothing).
whenToUse: User asks to change, extend, or fix an existing generative view
Iterating on a view you created earlier in the conversation
whenNotToUse: The view is legacy-format or a bundled template (read-only)
